paper_title: MICROSCOPE mission: first constraints on the violation of the weak equivalence principle by a light scalar dilaton
notes: Paper constrains scalar fifth force via weak equivalence principle violation measured by MICROSCOPE satellite. Primary result: |α| < 10^-11 for scalar field coupled to baryon number (q=B) with mass m < 10^-12 eV (range λ > few 10^5 m). This represents one order of magnitude improvement over previous Eöt-Wash torsion pendulum constraints. The coupling α is defined as ∂ln(m_i)/∂φ/M_P (dimensionless). Secondary constraint: |α| < 10^-12 for q=B-L coupling. Data point represents the flat (mass-independent) bound valid for m_φ < 10^-12 eV, encoded as horizontal line from 10^-12 eV to 10^5 m (corresponding to the stated range).
